<#
.SYNOPSIS
Parser and PSScriptAnalyzer gate for one or more scripts.
.DESCRIPTION
Reports parser errors and Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer findings at Warning and Error.
Exits 1 when any script has a finding, 0 otherwise.
#>
[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string[]] $Paths
)

$total = 0
foreach ($path in $Paths) {
    $resolved = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $path).Path
    $tokens = $null
    $parseErrors = $null
    [void][System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($resolved, [ref] $tokens, [ref] $parseErrors)
    foreach ($parseError in $parseErrors) {
        Write-Output ('PARSE {0}:{1} {2}' -f $resolved, $parseError.Extent.StartLineNumber, $parseError.Message)
        $total++
    }
    $findings = @(Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer -Path $resolved -Severity Warning, Error)
    foreach ($finding in $findings) {
        Write-Output ('PSSA {0}:{1} {2} {3}' -f $resolved, $finding.Line, $finding.RuleName, $finding.Message)
        $total++
    }
    Write-Output ('CHECKED {0} parse={1} pssa={2}' -f $resolved, @($parseErrors).Count, $findings.Count)
}
Write-Output ('TOTAL findings={0} at {1}' -f $total, (Get-Date).ToString('s'))
if ($total -gt 0) { exit 1 }
exit 0
"
}

  "content": "#Requires -Version 7.0
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Stages named files, commits with a message file, and pushes the branch to its own remote branch (normal push).
.DESCRIPTION
    Copy of ~/.claude/scratch/hv-amendment-20261016-cc/Publish-Commit.ps1.
    Refuses to commit when files other than the named ones are staged, and never force-pushes.
    The push target is refs/heads/<branch> on origin, set as upstream, so a branch that was created
    tracking another remote branch never pushes into it. Supports -WhatIf for a dry run.
.PARAMETER Worktree
    The git worktree.
.PARAMETER Files
    Semicolon-separated worktree-relative paths to stage; a directory stages its changed files, and
    nothing outside the named paths may be staged.
.PARAMETER MessageFile
    Commit message file.
.PARAMETER Push
    Push after committing.
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess)]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Worktree,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Files,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $MessageFile,
    [switch] $Push
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

$paths = @($Files -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
Write-Output "Now: $((Get-Date).ToString('s'))"
$branch = (& git -C $Worktree rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD).Trim()
Write-Output "Branch: $branch"
if ($branch -in @('main', 'develop', 'HEAD')) { throw "Refusing to commit on $branch." }
Write-Output '--- status before ---'
$before = @(& git -C $Worktree status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all)
if ($before.Count -le 20) { $before } else { Write-Output "$($before.Count) changed paths (first 5 shown)"; $before | Select-Object -First 5 }

foreach ($p in $paths) {
    if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $Worktree $p))) { throw "Missing file: $p" }
}

if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess(($paths -join ', '), 'git add and commit')) {
    & git -C $Worktree add -- @paths
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git add failed' }
    $staged = @(& git -C $Worktree diff --cached --name-only)
    $extra = @($staged | Where-Object { $file = $_; -not @($paths | Where-Object { $file -eq $_ -or $file.StartsWith($_.TrimEnd('/') + '/') }) })
    if ($extra.Count -gt 0) { throw "Unexpected staged files: $($extra -join ', ')" }
    Write-Output '--- staged ---'
    & git -C $Worktree diff --cached --shortstat
    & git -C $Worktree commit -F $MessageFile
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git commit failed' }
    Write-Output ('Commit: ' + (& git -C $Worktree log -1 --format='%H %s'))
}

if ($Push) {
    $remoteRef = "refs/heads/$branch"
    $existing = @(& git -C $Worktree ls-remote origin $remoteRef)
    Write-Output "Remote $remoteRef before push: $(if ($existing.Count -gt 0) { $existing -join ' ' } else { '(absent)' })"
    if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("origin $remoteRef", 'git push (no force)')) {
        & git -C $Worktree push -u origin "HEAD:$remoteRef"
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git push failed' }
        $after = @(& git -C $Worktree ls-remote origin $remoteRef)
        Write-Output "Remote $remoteRef after push: $($after -join ' ')"
        Write-Output ('Local HEAD: ' + (& git -C $Worktree rev-parse HEAD))
    }
}
Write-Output '--- status after ---'
$after = @(& git -C $Worktree status --short --branch --untracked-files=all)
if ($after.Count -le 20) { $after } else { Write-Output "$($after.Count - 1) changed paths"; $after | Select-Object -First 1 }
"
}

# Triage Reporting

Use MCP Server triage for an incidental bug discovered while doing other work. Do not use triage for the user's active requested fix, assigned TODO, or current implementation target; fix that directly or track it through the normal TODO and requirements workflow.

Submit the report, then continue the current task. Do not expect immediate resolution, research, or TODO creation. Intake only returns the accepted queue state; background triage later groups reports, researches them, and may create a `BUG-TRIAGE-###` backlog TODO.

MCP Server-related reports, including MCP Server plugin bugs, are grouped into the registered `McpServer` workspace when that workspace exists. If no `McpServer` workspace is registered, the report stays in the submitting workspace.

## Tools

- Use `triage_report` to submit an incidental bug report.
- Native MCP clients may use `triage_status`; plugin/REPL callers must use schema-valid `workflow.triage.getReport`, `workflow.triage.getGroup`, or `workflow.triage.queryGroups` for status inspection.

## Report Shape

Include enough evidence for later research without leaving the active task:

- `title`: short problem statement.
- `summary`: observed failure and why it matters.
- `component`: product area, package, or plugin name.
- `affectedPaths`: relevant paths when known.
- `affectedSymbols`: relevant methods, commands, or API names when known.
- `errorSignature`: stable error text, status code, or exception type when known.
- `dedupeKey`: stable key when the same bug may be reported again.
- `evidence`: compact command output or reproduction context.

## REPL Example

```yaml
type: request
payload:
  requestId: req-20260625T120000Z-triage-report
  method: workflow.triage.report
  params:
    title: Plugin wrapper hides triage_report validation errors
    summary: The wrapper exits with success after a triage_report validation failure, masking the error.
    component: mcpserver-plugin
    affectedPaths:
      - lib/repl-invoke.ps1
    errorSignature: triage_validation_hidden
    reporterAgent: <your-agent>
```

After a successful response, record the returned `reportId`, `groupId`, `status`, and `quietDeadlineUtc` only if useful for the current audit trail, then continue the current task.

## PowerShell Object-Safe Example

When using the plugin PowerShell surface, prefer the exported shim helpers and `-ParamsObject` so the wrapper serializes the YAML payload:

```powershell
Import-Module (Join-Path $env:MCP_PLUGIN_ROOT 'lib/McpPluginShim.psm1') -Force
$params = New-McpTriageReportParams `
    -Title 'Plugin wrapper hides triage validation errors' `
    -Summary 'workflow.triage.report failures are not visible to the agent.' `
    -Component 'mcpserver-plugin' `
    -AffectedPaths @('lib/repl-invoke.ps1') `
    -ErrorSignature 'triage_validation_hidden' `
    -ReporterAgent '<your-agent>'
& (Join-Path $env:MCP_PLUGIN_ROOT 'lib/Invoke-McpPlugin.ps1') -Command Invoke -Method workflow.triage.report -ParamsObject $params
```

Use `New-McpTriageGetReportParams`, `New-McpTriageGetGroupParams`, and `New-McpTriageQueryGroupsParams` for object-safe status inspection through `workflow.triage.getReport`, `workflow.triage.getGroup`, and `workflow.triage.queryGroups`.

Finish and synchronize MCP-backed work: reconcile requirements, export wiki documents, run validation, commit/push, and close out the session-log turn.

## Trust and transport

Trust marker details only after the plugin's local status/bootstrap check confirms marker trust and workspace health (including signature and nonce health). Use the plugin's supported wrapper surface for MCP mutations (for example `lib/repl-invoke.ps1`, or the plugin's session, todo, and requirements tools); do not use raw REST for normal MCP mutations.

## Method-name disambiguation

`workflow.*` names in this skill (`workflow.sessionlog.*`, `workflow.todo.*`, `workflow.requirements.*`) are plugin workflow/REPL method names, not literal native MCP tool names. Native `/mcp-transport` tools use names such as `sessionlog_*`, `todo_*`, and `requirements_*` (for example `sessionlog_submit`, `todo_list`, `requirements_generate`); hosted-agent adapters may expose `mcp_*` aliases. Do not declare the plugin unavailable solely because generic MCP discovery does not list literal `workflow.*` names.

If your agent exposes only a `pwsh` (or shell) tool, invoke the plugin shim directly instead of declaring it unavailable:

```
pwsh.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File "<plugin-root>\lib\repl-invoke.ps1" -Method <workflow.method> -ParamsYaml <yaml>
```

## Wrap-up steps

1. Reconcile requirements with `workflow.requirements.*`, including requirement reconciliation for new FR/TR/TEST evidence.
2. Export wiki requirements with `workflow.requirements.generateDocument` using `format: wiki` and `docType: all`.
3. Run validation commands and keep zero-failure zero-skip evidence.
4. If commit/push is required, apply an appropriate commit message and sync with origin.
5. Perform session-log reconciliation with `workflow.sessionlog.appendDialog` and `workflow.sessionlog.appendActions`.
6. Finish with `workflow.sessionlog.completeTurn`; use `workflow.sessionlog.failTurn` when validation, export, or commit/push cannot be completed (validation failure, export failure, or blocked commit/push).

  "file_path": "/home/sharpninja/.claude/scratch/pr82-review-20261019/Merge-BaseIntoBranch.ps1",
  "content": "#Requires -Version 7.0
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Fetches origin and merges a base ref into the checked-out effort branch with a normal merge commit
    (message file, no fast-forward, never a force), then prints the result. Refuses on main, develop or a
    detached HEAD, and when the merge would touch a path that is modified in the working tree. Supports -WhatIf.
.PARAMETER Worktree
    The git worktree of the effort branch.
.PARAMETER BaseRef
    Ref to merge, for example origin/develop.
.PARAMETER MessageFile
    Merge commit message file.
.PARAMETER Push
    Push the branch to its own remote branch after the merge (normal push).
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess)]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Worktree,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $BaseRef,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $MessageFile,
    [switch] $Push
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Write-Output "Now: $((Get-Date).ToString('s'))"
$branch = (& git -C $Worktree rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD).Trim()
if ($branch -in @('main', 'develop', 'HEAD')) { throw "Refusing to merge into $branch." }
& git -C $Worktree fetch --quiet origin
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git fetch failed' }
$head = (& git -C $Worktree rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
$base = (& git -C $Worktree rev-parse $BaseRef).Trim()
$mergeBase = (& git -C $Worktree merge-base HEAD $BaseRef).Trim()
Write-Output "Branch $branch head=$head; $BaseRef=$base; merge-base=$mergeBase"
$incoming = @(& git -C $Worktree diff --name-only "$mergeBase..$base")
Write-Output "Incoming files: $($incoming.Count)"
$incoming | Select-Object -First 40 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "  $_" }
$dirty = @(& git -C $Worktree status --porcelain=v1 --untracked-files=all | ForEach-Object { $_.Substring(3) })
$overlap = @($incoming | Where-Object { $dirty -contains $_ })
if ($overlap.Count -gt 0) { throw "Refusing: incoming changes touch modified paths: $($overlap -join ', ')" }
if ($base -eq $mergeBase) { Write-Output "Nothing to merge: $BaseRef is already in $branch."; return }

if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("$BaseRef into $branch", 'git merge --no-ff')) {
    & git -C $Worktree merge --no-ff --no-edit -F $MessageFile $BaseRef
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git merge failed; resolve before continuing' }
    Write-Output ('Merge: ' + (& git -C $Worktree log -1 --format='%H %P %s'))
    if ($Push) {
        $remoteRef = "refs/heads/$branch"
        & git -C $Worktree push -u origin "HEAD:$remoteRef"
        if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git push failed' }
        Write-Output "Remote $remoteRef after push: $(& git -C $Worktree ls-remote origin $remoteRef)"
    }
}
"
}

  "content": "#Requires -Version 7.0
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Pushes the current branch of a worktree to refs/heads/<branch> on origin with a normal push (never force), after
    checking that the local HEAD equals the expected commit, and reads the remote ref back. Supports -WhatIf.
.PARAMETER Worktree
    The git worktree.
.PARAMETER ExpectedSha
    The commit HEAD must be before the push.
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess)]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $Worktree,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [ValidatePattern('^[0-9a-f]{40}$')] [string] $ExpectedSha
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Write-Output "Now: $((Get-Date).ToString('s'))"
$branch = (& git -C $Worktree rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD).Trim()
if ($branch -in @('main', 'develop', 'HEAD')) { throw "Refusing to push $branch." }
$head = (& git -C $Worktree rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
Write-Output "Branch: $branch HEAD: $head expected: $ExpectedSha match: $($head -eq $ExpectedSha)"
if ($head -ne $ExpectedSha) { throw 'HEAD is not the expected commit; nothing pushed.' }
$remoteRef = "refs/heads/$branch"
$before = @(& git -C $Worktree ls-remote origin $remoteRef)
Write-Output "Remote $remoteRef before push: $(if ($before.Count -gt 0) { $before -join ' ' } else { '(absent)' })"
if ($PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess("origin $remoteRef", "git push $ExpectedSha (no force)")) {
    & git -C $Worktree push origin "HEAD:$remoteRef"
    if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'git push failed' }
    $after = @(& git -C $Worktree ls-remote origin $remoteRef)
    Write-Output "Remote $remoteRef after push: $($after -join ' ')"
    if (-not ($after -join ' ').StartsWith($ExpectedSha, [StringComparison]::Ordinal)) { throw 'Remote ref does not match the pushed commit.' }
}
"
}

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Reconciles one FR that the operator already ordered converted and deleted (IMPL-UNITGREEN-001: FR-MCP-USECASE-017,
    operator 2026-10-19T17:04 "FR-001, delete FRs (Recommended)" and "Only 016 and 017 (Recommended)") but that the
    store reads back as present (hostile validation round 3, finding R3-F3). Through the plugin only: reads the FR
    (getFr) and the effective requirement view (effective), refuses when any mapping still names the FR, deletes it
    (deleteFr), then reads getFr twice and the effective view again, and proves the replacement mappings of the
    parent FR still hold the expected TRs. Exit 1 when the FR is still visible afterwards. Supports -WhatIf.
.PARAMETER FrId
    The FR to delete.
.PARAMETER ParentFrId
    The FR whose mappings must keep the replacement TRs.
.PARAMETER ReplacementTrIds
    Semicolon-separated TRs that must stay mapped under the parent.
#>
[CmdletBinding(SupportsShouldProcess)]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [ValidatePattern('^FR-[A-Z0-9-]+$')] [string] $FrId,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [ValidatePattern('^FR-[A-Z0-9-]+$')] [string] $ParentFrId,
    [Parameter(Mandatory)] [string] $ReplacementTrIds
)

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
. (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot 'CcPlugin.ps1')

function Get-FrState {
    param([string] $Id)
    $r = Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.requirements.getFr' -Params ([ordered]@{ id = $Id })
    $result = Get-CcValue (Get-CcValue $r.Parsed 'payload') 'result'
    if ($null -eq $result) { return 'absent' }
    return ('present createdAt={0} criteria={1}' -f (Get-CcValue $result 'createdAt'), @(Get-CcValue $result 'acceptanceCriteria').Count)
}

function Test-InEffectiveView {
    param([string] $Id)
    $r = Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.requirements.effective' -Params ([ordered]@{})
    if ($r.ExitCode -ne 0) { throw "effective view read failed: exit $($r.ExitCode)" }
    return $r.Raw.Contains($Id, [StringComparison]::Ordinal)
}

function Get-MappingRow {
    param([string] $Id)
    $m = Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.requirements.listMappings' -Params ([ordered]@{ frId = $Id })
    $items = @(Get-CcValue (Get-CcValue (Get-CcValue $m.Parsed 'payload') 'result') 'items' | Where-Object { $null -ne $_ })
    return , $items
}

Write-Output "Now: $((Get-Date).ToString('s')) fr=$FrId parent=$ParentFrId"
Write-Output "BEFORE getFr: $(Get-FrState -Id $FrId)"
Write-Output "BEFORE effective view names it: $(Test-InEffectiveView -Id $FrId)"
$own = Get-MappingRow -Id $FrId
Write-Output "BEFORE mappings naming it: $($own.Count)"
if ($own.Count -gt 0) { throw "$FrId still has mappings; refusing to delete" }
$replacement = @($ReplacementTrIds -split ';' | Where-Object { $_ })
$parentText = (Get-MappingRow -Id $ParentFrId | ForEach-Object { $_ | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress }) -join ' '
foreach ($tr in $replacement) { Write-Output "BEFORE parent maps ${tr}: $($parentText.Contains($tr, [StringComparison]::Ordinal))" }

if (-not $PSCmdlet.ShouldProcess($FrId, 'workflow.requirements.deleteFr')) { return }
$d = Invoke-CcPlugin -Method 'workflow.requirements.deleteFr' -Params ([ordered]@{ id = $FrId })
Write-Output "deleteFr exit=$($d.ExitCode)"
if ($d.ExitCode -ne 0) { Write-Output $d.Raw }

$first = Get-FrState -Id $FrId
Start-Sleep -Seconds 5
$second = Get-FrState -Id $FrId
$inView = Test-InEffectiveView -Id $FrId
Write-Output "AFTER getFr: $first; again after 5 s: $second"
Write-Output "AFTER effective view names it: $inView"
$parentText = (Get-MappingRow -Id $ParentFrId | ForEach-Object { $_ | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 -Compress }) -join ' '
$kept = $true
foreach ($tr in $replacement) {
    $has = $parentText.Contains($tr, [StringComparison]::Ordinal)
    if (-not $has) { $kept = $false }
    Write-Output "AFTER parent maps ${tr}: $has"
}
if ($first -ne 'absent' -or $second -ne 'absent' -or $inView -or -not $kept) { Write-Output 'RESULT: still visible or replacement lost'; exit 1 }
Write-Output 'RESULT: absent from getFr and the effective view; replacement mappings kept'
"
}
